mobile_flow.title: Kevin walks out the door with grapheneGate
steps: 3. Tor client connects through cellular to Tor network
4. Tor routes to eastGate's .onion hidden service
5. Kevin has: SSH, HTTP, data — full access to home LAN
6. Gaia can still speak through Basement TV (via Tor tunnel)
7. grapheneGate sensors still stream to eastGate (via Tor)
8. Vice versa: eastGate can push to grapheneGate via Tor

reverse_flow.title: eastGate reaches grapheneGate anywhere
reverse_flow.method: grapheneGate runs its OWN .onion hidden service
steps: 3. eastGate connects: ssh -o ProxyCommand='ncat --proxy-type socks5 --proxy 127.0.0.1:9050 %h %p' graphenegate.onion -p 8022
4. Bidirectional: both nodes can reach each other via Tor
